title: Curd formation
back: Lactic acid coagulates and partly digests milk proteins. LAB in the stomach also check harmful microbes.

title: Microbes → industrial products
back: Lactobacillus → lactic acid; Saccharomyces → ethanol. Enzymes: lipases (detergents), pectinases and proteases (clear juices).

title: Streptokinase, cyclosporin, statins
back: Clot buster | immunosuppressant for transplants | lowers cholesterol by competitively inhibiting its synthesis.

title: Penicillin
back: First antibiotic, found by chance on a Staphylococcus plate. Nobel Prize 1945.

title: Sewage treatment
back: Primary (physical) → aeration tank (flocs, BOD falls) → settling tank (activated sludge; some returns) → anaerobic digester (biogas).

title: BOD
back: Secondary treatment continues until BOD is reduced. Ganga and Yamuna Action Plans built STPs.

title: Biogas plant
back: Dung slurry → digester (Methanobacterium) → floating gas holder → gas to homes; spent slurry is manure. IARI and KVIC.

title: Biocontrol agents
back: Baculoviruses (Nucleopolyhedrovirus) are species-specific, narrow-spectrum: ideal for IPM.

title: Biofertilisers
back: Symbiotic N | free-living N | mycorrhiza gives phosphorus | cyanobacteria in paddy fields.

title: Swiss cheese holes
back: Large holes from lots of CO₂. Roquefort cheese is ripened by fungi.
